("app"."workflow_step_runs"."status" = 'waiting' and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."started_at" is null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."ended_at" is null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."duration_ms" is null)
        or ("app"."workflow_step_runs"."status" in ('running', 'retrying') and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."started_at" is not null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."ended_at" is null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."duration_ms" is null)
        or ("app"."workflow_step_runs"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'skipped') and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."started_at" is not null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."ended_at" is not null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."ended_at" >= "app"."workflow_step_runs"."started_at" and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."duration_ms" is not null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."duration_ms" >= 0)

workflow_step_runs_error_shape.name: workflow_step_runs_error_shape
workflow_step_runs_error_shape.value: ("app"."workflow_step_runs"."status" = 'failed' and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."error_code" is not null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."error_message" is not null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."error_retryable" is not null) or ("app"."workflow_step_runs"."status" <> 'failed' and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."error_code" is null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."error_message" is null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."error_retryable" is null)

workflow_step_runs_agent_shape.name: workflow_step_runs_agent_shape
workflow_step_runs_agent_shape.value:
("app"."workflow_step_runs"."step" in ('coverage_analysis', 'consistency_analysis', 'interview_decision', 'conductor_question_generation')
          and (("app"."workflow_step_runs"."status" = 'succeeded' and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."agent_run_id" is not null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."output" is not null)
            or ("app"."workflow_step_runs"."status" <> 'succeeded' and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."agent_run_id" is null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."output" is null)))
        or ("app"."workflow_step_runs"."step" not in ('coverage_analysis', 'consistency_analysis', 'interview_decision', 'conductor_question_generation')
          and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."agent_run_id" is null and "app"."workflow_step_runs"."output" is null)

workflow_step_runs_json_objects.name: workflow_step_runs_json_objects
workflow_step_runs_json_objects.value: ("app"."workflow_step_runs"."input" is null or jsonb_typeof("app"."workflow_step_runs"."input") = 'object') and ("app"."workflow_step_runs"."output" is null or jsonb_typeof("app"."workflow_step_runs"."output") = 'object')
